name: Hidden half
original_name: ฮิดเด้นฮาล์ฟ
overview: Prim meets Frame, the senior she once fell for, sweet memories from the past come rushing back, along with feelings that seem to have never truly faded. But the more time they spend together, the deeper those feelings grow... and the more questions begin to arise. Because something about them feels strangely, inexplicably familiar. The love you believed in... may hold secrets you never saw coming.
